cases.input: One logical service is deployed in EU and US runtime environments.
cases.expect: One software-system identity references two distinct environments and regional instances.

cases.input: Node N1 is retired at T2 and N2 replaces it before T3.
cases.expect: T1 impact returns N1 and old instances; T3 returns N2 and successors with N1 tombstone retained.

cases.input: The same IP address is later assigned to another tenant resource.
cases.expect: Resources remain distinct because address is an effective-dated observation, not identity.

cases.input: One topology source is stale or unavailable.
cases.expect: Impact result reports incomplete coverage rather than no impact.

cases.input: One owned chassis is capitalized and also under configuration control.
cases.expect: Physical item, asset record and CI designation remain distinct and linked by effective evidence.

cases.input: All nodes of a logical cluster are replaced.
cases.expect: Cluster identity remains stable while membership edges close and reopen.

cases.input: Declared desired version differs from discovered running version.
cases.expect: Both assertions and drift remain visible; neither silently overwrites the other.
